RFC2545-3-1.note: Incremental M30 source audit, 2026-10-22, retaining the prior independent full-audit verdict in scratch/audit-ipv6/rfc2545.json and canonical rfc/audit/rfc2545.json; untouched carriers were not reread in this increment. RFC 2545 Section 3: "A BGP speaker shall advertise to its peer in the Network Address of Next Hop field the global IPv6 address of the next hop, potentially followed by the link-local IPv6 address of the next hop." Read all four scoped origination tagged wrappers and their complete testAPIOriginateIPv6NextHop and testOriginatedPolicyForwardQueue helpers. The repaired Session calls Negotiate with peerOffering(families...) on both sides, retaining capability 77 only for its explicit case and IPv4 for the mixed sibling case. peerOffering emits Multiprotocol capabilities; Negotiate intersects the offerings and defaults only an empty MP offering to classic IPv4. The actual consumer adjOutWrite.section checks Session.negotiated.SupportsFamily: the corrected offerings therefore admit legitimate IPv6 rather than silently removing it at the final writer. Exact complete-frame, error/reason, sent-count, hasAdvertised and policy-call assertions are unchanged. Invalid loopback, unspecified, multicast, native IPv4, absent and unnegotiated standalone link-local cases remain refused; the mixed case still requires the exact healthy IPv4 frame, and named commit additionally requires the later healthy IPv6 group. Mapped and capability-77 controls retain their separate family/capability contracts rather than extending the RFC quote. Read builder admission in buildBatchAnnounceUpdate, buildRIBRouteUpdate and CommitService.buildMPReachNLRI, plus effective post-policy admission in writeUpdateGated. FinalAccept is explicitly consumed by PolicyFilterChain; runEgressPolicyChainASN4 forwards raw replacement to exportFilterForBody before normalization and final validation. The queued maintenance subcase still demands two real queued items and exact healthy-sibling output. No new issue found in this incremental scope. No runtime proof, discrimination renewal, gate or stamping was run by this auditor; parent owns those results.

RFC2545-3-2.note: Incremental M30 source audit, 2026-10-22; retain the prior full-audit verdict without claiming to reread untouched carriers. RFC 2545 Section 3: "The value of the Length of Next Hop Network Address field on a MP_REACH_NLRI attribute shall be set to 16, when only a global address is present, or 32 if a link-local address is also included in the Next Hop field." The four scoped origination tagged units still invoke the complete shared helper, whose literal successful frames pin next-hop length 0x10 and the exact address/NLRI bytes. Four-octet and VPN-shaped 24/48-octet IPv6-unicast policy fields remain negative cases, with exact refusal and no successful advertisement accounting, rather than shortened successful frames. Read message.ValidateMPNextHop and ValidateIPv6NextHop, plus writeUpdateGated, which judges actual effective field width and roles before ownership admission. Correct MP offerings on both sides prevent the family consumer from discarding valid IPv6; the mixed case explicitly offers IPv4 too, preserving its exact sibling oracle. The ordinary joint-subnet helpers independently retain exact complete 0x20 pair and 0x10 global-only frames on API batch, queued drain and named commit. The ordinary_growth_test.go extended-message override now appends ExtendedMessage to the dual-family offering rather than erasing it; its unchanged helper requires the complete 32-octet pair, bounded frames, every ordered NLRI exactly once, one policy invocation and a healthy subsequent send. This growth fixture is contextual evidence, not a new RFC tag. No assertion, claim or timeout changed in the scoped diff. Source-semantic retention only: no test, race run, discriminator, gate or stamp executed here.

RFC2545-3-3.note: Incremental M30 source audit, 2026-10-22; retain the existing partial verdict and both existing code guards. RFC 2545 Section 3: "The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if and only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to." Tested: "only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to." Gap: "The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if". Producer: internal/component/bgp/reactor/link_scope.go::linkLocalNextHop, with internal/component/bgp/reactor/link_scope.go::classify. Reread both complete guarded functions: classify identifies externally owned globals as ThirdParty; linkLocalNextHop returns no address for ThirdParty/Unspecified and never substitutes the configured speaker link-local. A third-party global alone on a common subnet therefore still lacks the required matching link-local; this increment does not close that implementation gap or earn whole-requirement credit. Reread TestOrdinaryIPv6OwnGlobalJointSubnet, TestOrdinaryIPv6PolicyPairJointSubnet and their complete helpers. Dual-family Session negotiation restores IPv6 admission and preserves IPv4-dependent helper uses. Exact pair-on-common-subnet/global-only-off-link frames, NLRI, accounting, EOR and policy-call assertions remain unchanged on all three ordinary rails. normalizeOrdinaryNextHop judges the effective raw replacement, validates both slots before trimming, retains peer-owned-address refusal, and uses one prefix containing recipient and global. TestOrdinaryIPv6NormalizationPreservesAdmission retains exact invalid-pair refusals with and without optional capability 77. These are explicit prefix snapshots and available own-address/supplied-pair controls, not a new observation of physical adjacency or third-party discovery. Untouched functional, interop, forwarding and replay carriers were not reread; their earlier independent audit is retained, not recreated. RFC2545-3-6 remains unimplemented in canonical metadata and is deliberately absent from this merge input. No runtime proof or native discrimination freshness is asserted; parent owns renewals and stamping.

RFC2545-3-4.note: Incremental M30 source audit, 2026-10-22; retain the prior full-audit verdict, not a fresh whole-carrier audit. RFC 2545 Section 3: "In all other cases a BGP speaker shall advertise to its peer in the Network Address field only the global IPv6 address of the next hop (the value of the Length of Network Address of Next Hop field shall be set to 16)." Reread both scoped ordinary joint-subnet tagged units and all helpers. TestOrdinaryIPv6PolicyPairJointSubnet starts with a different off-subnet global, then supplies the effective speaker-owned pair through the real export-policy seam. Exact complete-frame oracles require the unchanged NLRI and 16-octet global alone for the off-link recipient, and the complete 32-octet pair for its common-subnet control. TestOrdinaryIPv6OwnGlobalJointSubnet supplies the corresponding configured-own-address inclusion control. API batch, queued initial drain and named commit keep successful delivery, EOR, production sent accounting, hasAdvertised and exact policy-call assertions. newOrdinaryJointPeer now offers IPv4 and IPv6 to both sides of Session negotiation; this repairs family admission without bypassing exportFilterForBody, normalizeOrdinaryNextHop or the final writer. Read the PolicyModify/raw consumer chain and the final ownership family dispatch, not merely the fixture producer. Invalid original pairs remain unnormalized for final refusal, so off-link trimming cannot conceal malformed roles or a peer-owned second address. A missing third-party link-local does not establish the otherwise antecedent; that separate RFC2545-3-3 partial bound and RFC2545-3-6 unimplemented disclosure remain intact. Untouched carriers are carried forward from the existing independent audit, not claimed reread here. No new patch-introduced defect found in this scope, and no runtime check, discrimination renewal or stamp run by this auditor.

RFC2545-3-6.note: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor, after 990744517c). Section 3: "The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if and only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to." The only change to linkLocalNextHop is the per-family linkLocalCondition argument (RFC 4659 peer-only condition for VPN-IPv6, RFC 2545 joint condition otherwise); the switch on nextHopRouter still returns the zero address for nextHopRouterThirdParty and nextHopRouterUnspecified, and classify still names Speaker only for the connected endpoint, configured local address and held addresses. So a configured/static/API route or explicit rewrite naming another on-link router by its global still has no source for that router's link-local, and the speaker's own is correctly not substituted. Gap stands; {gap} annotation and Partial public support remain accurate.
